"""Controller for VLABench heat_food, instance i00."""
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

r = Robot()
SPEC = r.spec()


def observe(cameras=("forward", "left", "right", "wrist"), depth=True):
    return r.get_obs(cameras=list(cameras), include_depth=depth, video="frames")


def send(target, seconds, note=""):
    """Hold an absolute 9D joint target for seconds (rounded to 0.1 s)."""
    n = max(1, round(seconds / SPEC["control_dt"]))
    a = np.repeat(np.asarray(target, dtype=np.float64)[None, :], n, axis=0)
    return r.submit("joint_position", a, dt=SPEC["control_dt"], interpolate="linear",
                    cameras=["forward"], video="none", note=note)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(SPEC)
    print(r.status())

+    """Move the hand in xyz using measured TCP feedback and a Broyden-updated Jacobian."""
+    J = INITIAL_POSITION_JACOBIAN.copy() if jacobian is None else np.array(jacobian, dtype=float).copy()
